com.frantzvardman.purebeats:
Cleaner look: simpler headings and no boxes around everything.
New: a quick guide the first time you open the app (skip it any time). Long-press the app icon for How to use or Contact support. No buttons in the way.
New: Beat Pad. Make beats from scratch: 8 drum pads and a 16-step grid that plays live while you edit. Tempo, swing, 3 kits, 4 patterns, mute, record your pad taps, save projects, and export the beat with stems and a certificate.
The old beat generator is still here as Idea maker.

com.frantzvardman.crownrush:
Harder and never boring: danger steps up every 5 levels, the Bomb King returns every 10 levels stronger each time, and every 25 levels a 20-second CATACLYSM hits. Bullion Run: upgrades now go to level 15, the road gets tougher every 5 days, a boss day every 10 (beat the Bomb Baron) and a meteor cataclysm every 25.

New: a quick guide the first time you open the app (skip it any time). Long-press the app icon for How to use or Contact support. No buttons in the way.
New: Today's board. A daily leaderboard everyone sees: put a nickname on your best run (gold in the main game, distance in Bullion Run). It starts fresh every day.
New: Watch the CPU play. A computer player plays Bombs & Bullion or Bullion Run by itself (normal, x4 or x10 speed), checks for bugs as it goes and keeps a log you can copy. Nothing it does is saved.
New mode: Bullion Run! Drive your hero across Bomb Bot country to the Gold Vault. Hold GAS, tilt in the air to land flat, smash bots and walls, and fire your rocket. When the gas runs out, cash in, upgrade your ride in the garage (engine, gearbox, wheels, gas tank, rocket, Gold Blaster, Bot Plow) and go again. 5 rides, 3 roads. Gold is shared with the main game.

com.frantzvardman.freelane:
Fixed: right after an app is updated, Free Lane could say "the download didn't match the store's fingerprint". It now re-checks the store before refusing.
New for beta testers: Updates → Beta tester. Add your tester code (or tap Connect Free Lane on your invite page) and Free Lane lets Frantz know which apps you install. Nothing is shared if you're not a tester. Also fixed: bottom-bar labels now sit under their icons.
New look: cleaner and simpler, like F-Droid. A plain top bar with search, check-for-updates and help; big round icons for new apps; clean lists without boxes; a new bottom bar.
Fixed: installing big apps like Rex Voice (about 230 MB). Free Lane now waits long enough for Android to finish installing them, and if your connection drops mid-download it picks up where it left off instead of starting over.
New: a quick guide the first time you open the app (skip it any time). Long-press the app icon for How to use or Contact support. No buttons in the way.
Free Lane now checks for updates every time you open it or come back to it, and asks you right away when one is ready, for every app on your phone, however you first installed it.
